limit_identity.rule: One immutable LimitSetId and revision is evaluated against one telemetry ItemId definition and engineering unit.
limit_identity.replacement_rule: Changing a threshold, unit, enablement, or hysteresis creates a new limit revision.

limit_rules: Thresholds are finite typed values compatible with the telemetry engineering value and unit.
Enabled bands are ordered HARD_LOW <= SOFT_LOW <= SOFT_HIGH <= HARD_HIGH.
Disabled or absent bands remain explicit and are never synthesized from neighboring thresholds.
Boundary comparison inclusivity and any finite nonnegative hysteresis are fields of the immutable limit revision.
Raw values are not compared to engineering limits unless the limit set explicitly declares RAW as its value domain.

is_alarmed_result.boolean_projection: true only for WARNING_LOW, WARNING_HIGH, CRITICAL_LOW, or CRITICAL_HIGH; false only for NOT_ALARMED; INDETERMINATE has no boolean value
is_alarmed_result.atomicity_rule: Sample, limit revision, and result are pinned in one evaluation and returned together.
is_alarmed_result.no_sample_rule: No sample returns INDETERMINATE and never NOT_ALARMED.
is_alarmed_result.gap_rule: A gap returns INDETERMINATE until a complete resynchronized snapshot is evaluated.

transition_projection.deduplication: No event is emitted when state, sample identity, limit revision, and reason are unchanged.
transition_projection.durability: A projected transition and its observation-stream event commit atomically.
transition_projection.restart: Rebuild from the durable current sample and pinned limit revision; never invent a clear transition from missing evidence.
transition_projection.latching: Not provided by this read-only v0.7 projection; operator alarm lifecycle is outside this contract.

security_rules: Limit metadata and alarm results follow the telemetry item's server-side visibility policy.
Unauthorized callers receive no threshold, hidden item, result-count, or transition-timing information.
All values and reasons are bounded and contain no driver, database, or credential secrets.
